zh: 暗子按原位置走，走后翻开。明士象可过河。须应将，将帅不照面；无棋可走判负。三次重复或六十回合无吃子和棋。
en: Hidden pieces make their first move as their starting role, then reveal. Revealed advisors and elephants may cross the river. Escape check; kings cannot face. No legal move loses. Three repetitions or 60 rounds without capture draw.
